content: Meetettizanne Meetettontta Mehetanne Do7ata
GODAY Musessinne Aaroones hizgides,
«Hayssa Isra7eele naytas yootite, ‹Biitta bolla diza do7atappenne mehetappe intte maanayti hayssafe kaalli dizayta,
Toho qinccifilley phalqeththatanne banchikizayta miite.

« ‹Gido attiin banchikizayta gidi uttidi qinccifilley phalqettonttayta woykko banchikonttayta gidi uttidi qinccifilley phalqettidayta moopite; gaamellay banchikees shin qinccifilley phalqettontta gishshas izi inttes tuna gido.
Guppaley banchikees shin qinccifilley phalqettontta gishshas izi inttes tuna gido.
Harbaynoy
banchikeessishin qinccifilley phalqettontta gishshas izi inttes tuna gido.
Guddunththika moopite; iza qinccifilley phalqeth gidikkoka izi banchikontta gishshas inttes tuna gidi qoodetto.
Heytantti tuna gidida gishshas istta asho moopite; haray attoshin istta ahakka bochchofte.
« ‹Abba giddoninne shaafa haaththata giddon diza medheteththata abba giddofe qefeynne poqo mala galbay diza ubbaa miite.
Abba giddoninne shaafa haaththa giddon diza medheteththatappenne shemppora paxa diza hara medheteththata ubbaa giddofe qefeynne poqettiza galbay baynda ubbay inttes tuna gidida gishshas moopite.
Heytantti tuna gidida gishshas istta asho moopite; haray attoshin istta ahakka bochchofte.
Hessa gishshas haaththa giddon diza qefeynne poqettiza galbay istta bolla baynda medheteththati wurikka intte achchan ixettidayta gidetto.
« ‹Kafotappe hayssafe kaallizayti tuna gidida gishshas moopite. Heytanttika golle, qoollo, wole
Xilo, dumma dumma qommo phircota.
Dumma dumma quurota
Yanchcha, cancce gutto, haaththa kafo, gace zare ubbaa,
Gutto, biya, yindare
woyno, haaththa kafo, ankko,
zigile, saabissa geetettiza haaththa kafo zare ubbaa, jinjilaate geetettiza kafonne wurkawurkko.
« ‹Qefey dishin oyddu tohora qaaxxiza medheteththati wurikka tunata;
Heytantta giddofe guppanaas maaddiza geday diza medheteththata miite;
Heytikka boole zareta, xingota zaretanne gumbaro zare ubbaa.
Hinko qefey dishin oyddu tohora hemettiza medheteththata intte tuna mala qoodite.
« ‹Hayssafe kaalli dizayta bochchidaadey wuri omars gakkanaas tuna gidana.
« ‹Heytantta aha denththidaadey wurikka ba may7o haaththan meecco; meeccikokka omars gakkanaas izaadey tuna gido.
« ‹Qinccifilley isttas dishin phalqettonttaytinne banchikontta mehey wurikka inttes tuna gidana; heytantta bochchidaadey wurikka tunees.
Oyddu tohora dizaytappe qinccifilley baynda kanten hemettizayti wurikka intte achchan tunata gidetto; istta ahaa bochchidaadey omars gakkanaas tuna gido;
Heytantta aha denththidaadey wurikka ba may7o haaththan meecco; meeccikokka omars gakkanaas izaadey tuna gido; isttika intte achchan tuna.
« ‹Biittara gooshettizayta giddofe hayssafe kaallizayti inttes tuna gidetto; giroy, ecerey, zarey, korchchey, haylashoy, geeggey, wakkalaynne,
shaaqanchchay inttes tuna gidetto.
Biittara gooshettiza ubbatappe tuna gididayti haytantta; istta gidiin woykko istta aha bochchizaadey wuri omars gakkanaas tuna gido.

Istta ahay iza bolla wodhdhida miishshi wurikka tunees; hessika miththafe oosettida miishshati, may7oti, galba, karaxiite, ogoronne heytantta misatiza haratakka gujjees; istta aha bochchida miishshi wurikka haaththan gelidi gam7o; omars gakkanaas tuna gididi hessafe guye geesh gido.
Heytantta ahay mana miishshaa giddon gelikko he miishshaa giddon diza miishshi wurikka tuniza gishshas he mana miishshaza wodhite.
He mana miishshaafe haaththi iza bolla xokettida kaththi wurikka tuna gidees; izan diza uyettiza miishshika tuna gidees.
Ay ahaykka bochchida miishshi wurikka tuna gidida gishshas iza ixxite; mani medhdhida cooce gidiin otoy meqqo.
Heytantta ahay hara ubbaa tunisizaaz gidikkoka pultto haaththenne haaththi diza olla tunisenna.
Zereththas uttida kaththa bolla wodhdhiko zereththay tunenna.
Gidikkoka zereththa bolla haaththi gukki simmiin ahay bochchiko he zereththay hessafe guye tuna gidees.
« ‹Meetettiza mehe garsafe awaysikka hayqqiin he hayqeththaa bochchidaadey omars gakkanaas tuna.
Ay asikka he hayqeththaafe miikko ba may7o meecco; omars gakkanaas tuna gido; ay asikka he hayqeththa ahaa tookkiko ba may7o meecco; gidikkoka omars gakkanaas izaadey tuna gido.
« ‹Biittara gooshettiza ay medheteththati wurikka intte achchan meetettonttaazinne ixettidaaz gidetto.
Tiran gooshettiza, oyddu tohora bizayta, woykko daro tohoy dizayta ubbaaka moopite; istti intte matankka ixettidayta gidetto.
Heytanttafe awayssaka miidi inttena tunisopite.
Tani GODAA intte Xoossaa; tani harappe dumma gidida gishshas intteka dumma gidite; ba tiran gooshettizayta miidi intterkka inttena tunisopite.
Inttes GODAA gidanaas Gibxeppe inttena kaaleththa kessiday intte Xoossay tana; hessa gishshas tani dumma gidida mala intteka dumma gidite.
« ‹Meheta, do7ata, kafota, haaththa giddoninne biitta bolla tiran gooshettiza medheteththata ubbaa gishshas imettida wogay hayssa;

Wodhdhida wogaa mala geeshshatanne geesh gidonttayta giddon diza dummateth shaakki eranaas hessika meetettizaytanne meetettonttayta giddon diza dummateththaa shaakki eranaas intte lo7eththi naagettite.› »

footnotes.text: Harbayno: Harbaynoy issi issi bagga gamoththo qaalan eche geetettees.
Wole: Woley issi issi bagga gamoththo qaalan wodda woykko wuukko geetettees.
Yindare: Yindarey issi issi bagga gamoththo qaalan hazo woykko oy7are woykko hoqqa geetettees.
-30 Wakkala: Wakkalay issi issi bagga gamoththo qaalan yaro geetettees.
